slug: 2024-08-15 Mauritania Launches Digital ID for e-Services, Built on TECH5 Platform (Houwiyeti)

facts.fact: ID Tech Wire reports Mauritania launched the Houwiyeti digital identity app giving access to government e-services, with biometric login to the e-services portal demonstrated in the March 2023 pilot.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition, Innovation and Public Sector Modernisation (MTNIMA)
